data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Prevent the Atreides Battle advantage of seeing one element of any Battle Plan.
data.cunning: Force your opponent to show you a second element of their Battle Plan.
data.name: Atreides
data.secretAlly: During a battle, force your opponent to reveal your choice of one element of their Battle Plan: leader, weapon, defense, or number dialed.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Prevent the Bene Gesserit from using their Voice advantage.
data.cunning: You may flip any or all groups of your advisors to fighters during your turn in the Shipment and Movement phase (all troops in a territory must end up the same type).
data.name: Bene Gesserit
data.secretAlly: During a battle, you may use the Bene Gesserit Voice advantage of forcing your opponent to play or not play a Treachery Card.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Force CHOAM to discard a card at random from their hand, and gain no spice for it.
data.cunning: You may discard any Treachery Card to use any Worthless Card special effect.
data.name: CHOAM
data.secretAlly: You may either discard a Worthless Card and gain 2 spice during Spice Collection, or after winning a battle, you may look at a random card in your opponent's hand (not used in battle).

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Any time before Shipment and Movement, if Ecaz and their ally both have troops in a territory, force the Ecaz ally to return their troops (from one territory that contains both factions' troops) to their reserves.
data.cunning: Gain Duke Vidal for this turn (even if he is captured, in the Tleilaxu Tanks, or a ghola, overriding Moritani). At the end of this turn, set him aside normally.
data.name: Ecaz
data.secretAlly: Force one player to reveal whether or not they have any of your leaders as Traitors (though not which leaders).

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Force the Emperor to pay for their ally's Treachery Card during Bidding (at least as much spice as necessary) or, while making Battle Plans, prevent the Emperor from using their Sardaukar advantage.
data.cunning: Before formulating your Battle Plan, you may count 5 of your troops as Sardaukar if you have none in that battle.
data.name: Emperor
data.secretAlly: Keep your spice when buying a Treachery Card (you must show that you have the amount you would have paid) or, revive 3 additional troops beyond Revival limits during Revival for free.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Prevent Fremen from 'riding the worm' this turn, or prevent Fremen from moving 2 territories during Shipment and Movement.
data.cunning: If Shai-Hulud appears in a territory with no troops, any troops you have in one sand territory may 'ride the worm' to any territory subject to storm and occupancy rules.
data.name: Fremen
data.secretAlly: You may either avoid losing troops to Shai-Hulud, or revive a total of 3 of your troops for free during Revival.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Cancel a revealed Harkonnen traitor. Shuffle the traitor into the Traitor Deck, and then the Harkonnen player draws a new Traitor Card during the Mentat Pause.
data.cunning: Draw a Traitor Card and add it to your hand at any time. Then secretly shuffle any one of your Traitor Cards back into the Traitor Deck.
data.name: Harkonnen
data.secretAlly: During the Mentat Pause, draw two Traitor Cards and add them to your hand. Then shuffle two Traitor Cards you hold back into the Traitor deck.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Prevent Ixians from using either their Bidding advantage or their Technology advantage (but not both).
data.cunning: Before formulating your Battle Plan, you may count all of your Suboids in all battles this turn as counting full strength (without needing to support them with spice).
data.name: Ixians
data.secretAlly: You may discard a Treachery Card you just purchased during Bidding and then draw the top card of the Treachery deck.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Remove a Terror token from the board, returning it to Moritani. It is not revealed.
data.cunning: When you place a Terror token, it may be placed in any territory on Arrakis, even one that already has a Terror token.
data.name: Moritani
data.secretAlly: When you lose a battle that had a winner, keep one Treachery Card you played in the battle you would have been able to keep had you won.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Force Richese to discard a Richese Treachery Card they were going to buy (it is discarded and no spice is paid), or prevent Richese from receiving payment on a card they sell (spice goes to the Spice Bank).
data.cunning: You may use 2 No-Field tokens for a single shipment (still counting it as shipping 1 troop). Reveal one token immediately, to place in front of your shield.
data.name: Richese
data.secretAlly: You may discard a Treachery Card you just purchased during Bidding and then draw the top card of the Treachery deck.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Gain any one payment in full for Shipping that would have gone to either the Spacing Guild or the Spice Bank, even your own. This overrides collection from a faction occupying Junction.
data.cunning: You may make a second Shipment immediately after performing your Shipment and Movement. The second Shipment does not get to move unless you play Hajr.
data.name: Spacing Guild
data.secretAlly: Your shipment is at Guild rates, and you may also ship cross-planet or back to your reserves as your Shipping action.

data.about: GF9 Ecaz & Moritani Nexus card. Rules transcribed from the supplied 2022 original.
data.betrayal: Cancel a revealed Face Dancer. It remains revealed until Tleilaxu have revealed all of their Face Dancers.
data.cunning: Set aside all revealed Face Dancers. Secretly draw replacements and then shuffle the set-aside Face Dancers into the Traitor deck.
data.name: Tleilaxu
data.secretAlly: Revive one of your leaders for free and up to 5 of your troops for 1 spice each during Revival.

data.about: GF9 CHOAM & Richese expansion. Leader skill rules from the original printed card.

data.about: GF9 CHOAM & Richese expansion. Leader skill rules from the original printed card.

data.generalText: When you win a battle and lose troops, return 1 to your reserves instead of going to the Tleilaxu Tanks.

data.generalText: Add a +1 to your other leader discs when using a Projectile Weapon.
data.name: Swordmaster of Ginaz

data.generalText: Add +1 to your other leader discs when you play at least one Worthless card as part of your battle plan.

data.text: After turn 1, play in Storm after movement is determined but before the storm moves. You need forces on or adjacent to the Shield Wall, with no storm between those forces and the Wall. Destroy all forces on the Wall. Arrakeen, Carthag and Imperial Basin lose storm protection for the rest of the game. Place the Destroyed Shield Wall token and remove this card from the game.

data.name: GF9 Hajr
data.text: Play immediately after your movement in Shipment and Movement. Make one extra on-planet movement, subject to normal rules, with the same group or another group. Discard after use.

data.name: GF9 Karama
data.text: After setup, stop one use of a faction or alliance advantage. In battle, play before plans are revealed. Or pay any player's shipment to the Bank at Guild rates. Or bid without limit for a free Treachery Card, with room in hand. This purchase excludes Richese auctions. In Advanced, you may instead use your once-per-game Special Karama. Cannot stop special victory or Special Karama. Discard after use.
data.about: GF9 Treachery Card. Uses the corrected CHOAM & Richese wording where applicable.

data.name: GF9 Truthtrance
data.text: At any time, publicly ask one player one yes/no question about the game. They answer publicly and must do everything they can to keep that answer true this turn. If it becomes impossible, they are released. If the answer is beyond their ability to decide, they may say they do not know; ask another question or keep this card for later. Pause play until answered. Discard after use.
data.about: GF9 Treachery Card. Uses the corrected CHOAM & Richese wording where applicable.

data.name: GF9 Axlotl Tanks
data.about: If at least one faction takes free revival, gain 1 spice per Tech token you control, once this phase. No income if only Tleilaxu alone triggers it. Place income on this token and collect at phase end. A battle winner takes one Tech token of their choice from a defeated holder. A single faction holding all three counts as one stronghold; allies cannot pool them.

data.name: GF9 Heighliners
data.about: If at least one faction ships forces from off-planet, including to a Homeworld, gain 1 spice per Tech token you control, once this phase. No income if only Guild alone triggers it. Place income on this token and collect at phase end. A battle winner takes one Tech token of their choice from a defeated holder. A single faction holding all three counts as one stronghold; allies cannot pool them.

data.name: GF9 Spice Production
data.about: If at least one faction takes CHOAM Charity, gain 1 spice from the Bank per Tech token you control, once this phase. No income if the only collectors are Bene Gesserit and/or CHOAM using their faction Charity advantages. Place income on this token and collect at phase end. A battle winner takes one Tech token of its choice from a defeated holder. One faction holding all three counts as one stronghold; allies cannot pool them. Inflation never changes this income.

data.name: GF9 Atreides Ambassador
data.about: Atreides - See visitor's hand. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Harkonnen Ambassador
data.about: Harkonnen - Look at a random Traitor Card the visiting faction holds. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Fremen Ambassador
data.about: Fremen - Move a group of your forces on the board to any territory (subject to storm and occupancy rules). Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Emperor Ambassador
data.about: Emperor - Gain 5 spice. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Guild Ambassador
data.about: Guild - Send up to 4 of your forces in reserves to any territory not in storm for free. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Bene Gesserit Ambassador
data.about: Bene Gesserit - Trigger the effect of any Ambassador that was not part of your supply, then remove this Bene Gesserit Ambassador from the game. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Ixian Ambassador
data.about: Ixian - Discard a Treachery Card and draw from the deck. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Tleilaxu Ambassador
data.about: Tleilaxu - Revive one of your leaders or up to 4 of your forces for free. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 CHOAM Ambassador
data.about: CHOAM - Discard any of your Treachery Cards and gain 3 spice for each one. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Richese Ambassador
data.about: Richese - If your hand is not full, pay 3 spice to the Bank to draw the top Treachery Card. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Ecaz Ambassador
data.about: Ecaz - Gain Vidal if he is not in the Tanks, captured, or a ghola until used in a battle, or form an alliance with the visiting faction (if neither of you is allied and they agree); you may then give them control of Vidal for this turn. This token returns to your available supply. Ecaz may trigger this immediately when a faction other than its ally or the matching faction enters with non-advisor forces. The effect interrupts the entering action. See Ecaz rules for the Ecaz alliance/Vidal choice.

data.name: GF9 Ambassador Tokens
data.about: Eleven face-up Ambassadors. Ecaz starts with its own plus five random foreign Ambassadors. Keep the remaining foreign Ambassadors aside for later replacement draws after all five foreign Ambassadors have been used. Moritani has no Ambassador.

data.name: GF9 Assassination
data.about: Choose a random leader from that player, send it to the Tanks and collect its fighting strength in spice from the Bank (3 spice for Zoal).

data.name: GF9 Atomics
data.about: All forces in the territory go to the Tanks. Place the Atomics Aftermath token in the territory. No forces may ever ship into this territory (even Fremen). From this turn forward, your hand limit is reduced by 1 (as well as your ally's), discarding a random card if a hand exceeds the limit.

data.name: GF9 Extortion
data.about: Gain 5 spice from the Spice Bank, placed in front of your shield. Collect it in the Mentat Pause, then regain this Terror token unless any one player in storm order pays you 3 spice.

data.name: GF9 Robbery
data.about: Steal half the spice (rounded up) from that player or take the top card of the Treachery Deck (then discarding a card of your choice if you exceed your hand size).

data.name: GF9 Sabotage
data.about: Draw a random Treachery Card from that player and discard it if possible. Then you may give that player a Treachery Card of your choice from your hand.

data.name: GF9 Sneak Attack
data.about: Send up to 5 of your forces in reserves into that territory at no cost (subject to storm and occupancy rules), even if the Atomics Aftermath token is there.

data.name: GF9 Terror Tokens
data.about: Six hidden Moritani Terror tokens. Follow the Moritani rules for placement, triggering and permanent removal.

data.name: GF9 Atomics Aftermath
data.about: No force may ship into this territory for the rest of the game, including Fremen. Normal movement and an explicit Sneak Attack remain allowed. Place after resolving the Atomics Terror token.

data.name: GF9 No-Field 0
data.about: Hidden No-Field contains 0 forces, limited by reserves when revealed. Counts as one force while hidden, including the 0 token. Only one may be on Arrakis; the same number cannot be used consecutively.

data.name: GF9 No-Field 3
data.about: Hidden No-Field contains 3 forces, limited by reserves when revealed. Counts as one force while hidden, including the 0 token. Only one may be on Arrakis; the same number cannot be used consecutively.

data.name: GF9 No-Field 5
data.about: Hidden No-Field contains 5 forces, limited by reserves when revealed. Counts as one force while hidden, including the 0 token. Only one may be on Arrakis; the same number cannot be used consecutively.

data.name: GF9 Inflation
data.about: During Mentat Pause, place this token on CHOAM Charity with either Double or Cancel face up. Next turn, double or cancel all CHOAM Charity, including CHOAM and Bene Gesserit. At the following Mentat Pause flip it; at the next, remove it from the game. No spice bribes while Double is in play. Inflation does not change Tech Token income.

data.name: GF9 Spice Stash

data.name: GF9 Ornithopter

data.name: GF9 Hidden Mobile Stronghold
data.about: Ixian separate stronghold pointing at a sector of any non-stronghold territory, including the Polar Sink. Its occupants are protected from storm and worms. While Ixians occupy it, move it up to 3 territories before later storm movement is dialed or revealed; never into, out of or through storm. During its movement through a spice-bearing sector, immediately collect up to 2 spice per troop inside. Ixians may ship directly inside; other factions enter from the pointed territory by movement, with BG accompanying-shipment and Fremen worm-ride exceptions. It is separate for battles and counts as one stronghold.

data.about: Six copies in the base 21-card Spice Deck.

layers.content: Destroy spice and non-Fremen forces in the territory shown by the last Territory Card. A Nexus follows unless an exception applies. On turn 1, set this card aside and draw again. Resolve consecutive worms under the normal worm rules.

data.name: GF9 Sandtrout
data.about: Ixians & Tleilaxu Spice Card. Official Q&A anti-Nexus procedure. Sandtrout waits for the next Shai-Hulud; it does not cancel the current worm when drawn as its replacement.

layers.content: End existing alliances. The next Shai-Hulud produces no Nexus. Draw that worm's replacement. If it is another Shai-Hulud, resolve a normal Nexus. If it is a Spice Blow, double that blow. A blow drawn directly after Sandtrout is not doubled.

layers.content: Resolve as Shai-Hulud. In storm order, every player votes on whether a Nexus occurs. A majority must vote yes; a tie means no Nexus. Fremen may then ride the worm using any number of forces from reserves, subject to storm and occupancy.

Place 6 spice in its middle sector, unless that sector is in storm.
Place one random face-down Smuggler token in False Wall West, middle sector. Spacing Guild may inspect that hidden token.

data.name: GF9 Cheap Hero Traitor Card
data.about: Add this single card to the faction-generated Traitor deck when the first expansion is used. Do not substitute it for the Cheap Hero Treachery cards.

data.name: GF9 Kwisatz Haderach
data.about: Base Advanced Atreides card and battle-loss counter track.

layers.content: Activate after losing 7 force tokens in battles. In one territory per turn, accompany your leader or Cheap Hero for +2 strength. An accompanied leader cannot turn traitor. If the leader dies, lose the bonus. Only a Lasgun/Shield explosion kills the Kwisatz Haderach. Revive it for 2 spice under leader revival rules. Track battle losses: 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7.

data.name: GF9 Kwisatz Haderach
data.about: Advanced Atreides companion token. Activate after 7 force losses in battles. Use the matching reference card and faction rules.

data.name: GF9 Atreides Battle Loss Counter
data.about: Move on the Kwisatz Haderach reference card track when Atreides lose forces in battle. Activate the companion at 7 losses.
